title: Additive module lift for integral root transport
statement: The scalar semilinear additive map admits a morphism from the canonical module pullback whose underlying sheaf map satisfies the adjunction-unit section formula.

proof.text: The inverse-image coefficient map in PurCompactSupport.completed is the inverse adjoint of sfCompletedCoefficientMap. Applying the sheaf adjunction hom-equivalence and its unit formula therefore identifies proEtaleRingDirectImageMap with sfCompletedCoefficientMap.

Use PresheafOfModules.homMk on the given additive sheaf morphism. Its linearity condition is precisely hscalar after rewriting by the coefficient-map equality, so this constructs a morphism from the integral Tate module to its module direct image.

Apply the inverse hom-equivalence of proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction to this module morphism. The adjunction unit identity and Equiv.apply_symm_apply identify its direct-image composite with the original morphism; evaluation on each section gives the required formula.
